invariants: Generic archetype allowance never overrides exact UTP-106 source/material/process/tool evidence.
Every atmosphere transition and process exposure is an explicit build step.
Prior-layer thermal, chemical, mechanical, electrical, optical and contamination damage envelopes are checked before successor operations.

Sensitive layers CAN proceed through otherwise incompatible downstream operations only if a source-qualified protection, encapsulation, inert/vacuum hold, masking or alternate sequence closes the damage gate.
Raphael may compare bounded geometry/process candidates only after standard-physics baseline and equivalent material/environment constraints.
No architecture row grants physical, hazardous-process, certification, release or mission authority.
